summary: Helus Pharma Inc. (Nasdaq/Cboe CA: HELP), a Toronto-domiciled clinical-stage CNS company formerly known as Cybin, filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated October 15, 2026, announcing the appointment of Dr. Suresh Durgam, M.D., to its Board of Directors; he previously served on the company's Scientific Advisory Board. Durgam is the former EVP and Chief Medical Officer of Intra-Cellular Therapies, acquired by Johnson & Johnson in April 2025. The appointment remains subject to Cboe Canada approval. No shareholder vote, stake, price, or advisor is disclosed. What to watch: a strengthening of late-stage CNS development and regulatory expertise ahead of stated clinical, regulatory, and commercial milestones; the low-float dual-listing overhang and Cboe approval timing are the near-term catalysts.
